name: Taxes
description: State and federal tax rates and revenue.

questions.oppose_means: Favors keeping or raising the top state income tax rates.
questions.support_means: Favors lowering the top state income tax rates.
questions.text: Should California lower the state income tax rates paid by its highest earners?
questions.notes: Candidate stances on specific tax ballot measures are recorded separately as positions on the measure contest.

questions.oppose_means: Opposes a federal tax on very large fortunes (may still favor other tax changes for high earners or corporations).
questions.support_means: Favors a federal tax on very large fortunes, such as wealth above a high threshold.
questions.text: Should the federal government levy an annual tax on very large fortunes (a wealth tax)?
questions.notes: Federal question. Candidate stances on California's state billionaire-tax measure (Proposition 40) are recorded as positions on that measure's contest, not here.
